label: Bible Study
prompt: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their _____ is come up before me.
verse: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.
note: Jonah's assignment — go to Nineveh; he immediately bought a ticket to the opposite end of the map.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thy _____ come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
verse: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
note: The Lord's Prayer asks for heaven's kingdom to come and heaven's will to be done right here on earth.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king's words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and _____. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.
verse: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king's words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.
note: Nehemiah's pep talk worked: the people answered, 'Let us rise up and build' — and the wall went up in 52 days.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Keep back thy servant also from _____ sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
verse: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
note: Hidden faults in verse 12, deliberate sins here — David asks to be kept from both.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: As the _____ sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.
verse: As the partridge sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.
note: Ill-gotten riches are like a 'partridge' sitting on eggs that never hatch — 'at his end' such a man 'shall be a fool.'
